records.text: Lori Frantzve established the Everyday Heroes foundation, from which the Romanian Angels Project emerged to work with the military in Romania helping orphans.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Lori Frantzve established the Everyday Heroes Foundation, which was supposed to help children in need. ... what spun out from Lori's charity was the Romanian Angels Project ... they worked with the military in Romania to help orphans.

verification.notes: The project and military-orphanage portions are supported, but the founder attribution is not. In a contemporaneous first-person interview, Erika Frantzve identified herself as the founder of Everyday Heroes Like You and said its Romanian Angels project teamed with the U.S. Marine Corps to jointly sponsor an orphanage in Constanta. Romanian local reporting likewise says Romanian Angels began in 2012 after Erika visited the Antonio placement center and documents American military participation. These sources contradict the claim that Lori Frantzve established the foundation.
